document.longDescription:
The Children's Center at the Bronx Library Center lists NYPL After School among its free school-age services. The official event page says NYPL After School is a free drop-in program for kids ages 6-12 that runs after regular school hours on Mondays through Thursdays, with homework help from tutors or Teen Reading Ambassadors, reading recommendations, fun writing, STEAM activities, enrichment, and snacks.

The official Bronx Library Center event listing shows the program running from 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM across upcoming Monday-Thursday dates. No registration is required.

The branch lists the Children's Center on the second floor at 310 East Kingsbridge Road, Bronx, NY 10458, with phone 718-572-4220 and email blcchildren@nypl.org.

Sources: https://www.nypl.org/locations/bronx-library-center/blcchildren https://www.nypl.org/events/programs/2026/02/02/nypl-after-school-45
